# JobQueue class

A job queue that both pushes and handles jobs in the same process — the default export, and the one to start with.

Scheduling is per job and optional: push with no options to run as soon as a worker is free, with [PushOptions.delay](/api/job/latest/job.pushoptions.delay/) to run later, and with [PushOptions.ttl](/api/job/latest/job.pushoptions.ttl/) to stop retrying after a while. Register the handler with [JobQueue.onPop()](/api/job/latest/job.jobqueue.onpop/) before [JobQueue.start()](/api/job/latest/job.jobqueue.start/) — this class insists on it, because a combined queue with no handler would enqueue work that nothing consumes.

Split the two ends into [JobQueuePublisher](/api/job/latest/job.jobqueuepublisher/) and [JobQueueWorker](/api/job/latest/job.jobqueueworker/) when they belong in different processes, which is what scaling the workers out requires.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export default class JobQueue<T> extends BaseJobQueue<JobQueue<T>, T> implements AnyJobQueueWorker<JobQueue<T>, T>, AnyJobQueuePublisher<JobQueue<T>, T> 
```
**Extends:** [BaseJobQueue](/api/job/latest/job.basejobqueue/)<!-- -->&lt;[JobQueue](/api/job/latest/job.jobqueue/)<!-- -->&lt;T&gt;, T&gt;

**Implements:** [AnyJobQueueWorker](/api/job/latest/job.anyjobqueueworker/)<!-- -->&lt;[JobQueue](/api/job/latest/job.jobqueue/)<!-- -->&lt;T&gt;, T&gt;, [AnyJobQueuePublisher](/api/job/latest/job.anyjobqueuepublisher/)<!-- -->&lt;[JobQueue](/api/job/latest/job.jobqueue/)<!-- -->&lt;T&gt;, T&gt;

## Remarks

On SIGTERM, SIGINT or SIGABRT the underlying `@imqueue/core` queue releases its watcher locks and exits the process. That is orderly, but it is not a drain: a handler still running is not awaited, so the job it was working on loses that attempt. Turn on [JobQueueOptions.drain](/api/job/latest/job.jobqueueoptions.drain/) — or set `IMQ_DRAIN_ENABLE=1` — to wait for it instead.

## Example


```typescript
import JobQueue from '@imqueue/job';

const queue = new JobQueue<Email>({ name: 'Email' });

queue.onPop(async (email: Email) => {
    await send(email);
});

await queue.start();

queue.push({ to: 'a@b.c', subject: 'Hi' });
```
